description: This file defines a custom exception class 'OfficeTransactionNotFoundException' used to signal that an office transaction resource was not found. It extends a generic platform exception class and is used within the organization office exception package.

classes.name: OfficeTransactionNotFoundException
classes.description: A runtime exception indicating the specified office transaction ID is invalid or does not exist.

methods.name: OfficeTransactionNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new exception instance with a specific transaction ID, generating an appropriate error message.
